scientific_integrity: The proof combines an analytic Fourier-autocorrelation reduction, an exact zero-flip witness, and a complete transparent finite certificate. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three unit-grid occupied runs, each of at least two cells, with gaps of at least one cell
Recovery uniqueness only within the restricted model, modulo translation and reflection
Sharp minimum length and first fiber require the embedded finite exhaustive integer certificate
No stability theorem, classification of larger spans, or independent mathematical audit
Earlier unindexed equivalent enumeration remains an originality risk
title: The first no-singleton three-interval Fourier ambiguity on an integer grid
